Each forms one preliminary document: the product description (functional spec, UML, and identity management), the architecture, the error-handling design, or the concurrency patterns. Each analyst has its own skill and its own rule. decision.goal: Add formalizer, translator, and four document analysts, with a skill and a rule for each analyst, then formalize the four English documents and the four Ukrainian drafts and stop for the developer to publish the Ukrainian copies and approve Block 0 as a template.
decision.rationale: The new brief is the source of truth and replaces the revision-1 split in which formalizer wrote all four English documents. formalizer now only launches the analysts, checks integrity, and searches for conflicts. The brief does not name the analysts, so the names follow the four document roles already fixed for Block 0: product-analyst, architecture-analyst, error-handling-analyst, and concurrency-analyst. Their output files stay docs/product/spec.md, architecture.md, error-handling.md, and concurrency.md. A separate preliminary directory was rejected so the integrity check has those four files as its outputs. Holding the writes until after the check was rejected because an input invocation runs the analysts first and the check second. Letting a person invoke an analyst was rejected because the brief forbids it. Keeping the sentence "Do not merge, deploy, or start another agent." inside formalizer was rejected because that sentence would forbid the required launch. translator and the four analysts keep that sentence. formalizer instead says it does not merge or deploy and starts only those four analysts. The report follows the advisor pair style without copying the advisor execute-gate schema: English XML under audit/formalizer and a shorter Ukrainian markdown file under local/formalizer, one block-0 pair updated in place. Putting that report in local/block-0 was rejected so the Ukrainian product drafts stay the translator output. translator still only writes those drafts, now invoked as /translator, and it reads the report pair instead of audit/block-0/handoff.xml because that handoff belonged to the superseded writer role. Copying the old repository into this tree, creating apps/, adding a service or MCP, and editing planner, builder, tester, reviewer, advisor, or the setup pair stay rejected. An old-versus-final difference is not a conflict. A conflict is a disagreement about the final product among the Unimap 2.0 presentation, the thesis PDF, the thesis slides, and the current spec draft, or a disagreement among the four English output files. Developer launches stay blocked and out of the checkbox gate, the same pattern as the setup handoff and revision 1, so an empty box cannot stop the role files from being added. Status stays ready because no developer step is pending.

step.title: Add the Block 0 roles
step.details: Create .cursor/agents/formalizer.md, translator.md, product-analyst.md, architecture-analyst.md, error-handling-analyst.md, and concurrency-analyst.md. Use name, description, model inherit, and readonly false in the same frontmatter shape as .cursor/agents/planner.md. Write the bodies in English. Each agent answers the user in Ukrainian. Do not modify .cursor/agents/advisor.md, planner.md, builder.md, tester.md, or reviewer.md. Do not modify audit/advisor/2026-11-05-ADVISOR-setup.xml or local/advisor/2026-11-05-ADVISOR-setup.md. Do not write the product documents, do not create apps/, do not add a service or an MCP server, and do not copy https://github.com/juis6world/unimap.git into this working tree. Do not write a formalizer report in this step. translator.md and the four analyst files must each contain this exact sentence: Do not merge, deploy, or start another agent. formalizer.md must not contain that exact sentence. formalizer.md must contain: Do not merge or deploy. Start only product-analyst, architecture-analyst, error-handling-analyst, and concurrency-analyst, and only when /formalizer receives one existing input file whose name ends in .xml or .txt. Do not start advisor, planner, builder, tester, reviewer, or translator. formalizer is explicit only and is invoked with /formalizer. With no extra token, it does not launch the analysts. It checks the four English files and writes the report. With exactly one existing .xml or .txt path, it launches the four analysts on that path, waits until all four finish, and then runs the same check. Any other invocation stops without launching and without writing a report. The check does not edit the product files. Integrity is ok only when docs/product/spec.md, architecture.md, error-handling.md, and concurrency.md all exist, none of them is empty, and spec.md contains the strings architecture.md, error-handling.md, and concurrency.md. A conflict is a disagreement about the final product among docs/Unimap_2.0_презентація.pdf, docs/Дипломна_робота_Зозуля_Олег.pdf, docs/Презентація_дипломна_робота_Зозуля_Олег.pdf, and the current spec draft, or a disagreement among the four English files. A difference between the public repository and the Unimap 2.0 presentation is not a conflict. The report pair is audit/formalizer/YYYY-MM-DD-FORMALIZER-block-0.xml in English and local/formalizer/YYYY-MM-DD-FORMALIZER-block-0.md in Ukrainian. The markdown file is shorter than the XML file. YYYY-MM-DD is the UTC date of the first write. Later runs update that pair in place and do not create a second pair. Both files contain the line integrity: ok or the line integrity: failed, and either the line conflicts: none or one line beginning with conflict: for each conflict. formalizer does not write the four product documents and does not write into audit/advisor/ or local/advisor/. When both lines are integrity: ok and conflicts: none, it tells the developer in Ukrainian to launch translator. Otherwise it tells the developer in Ukrainian to write local/notes/block-0-resolutions.txt and run /formalizer with that file. Each analyst description says a person must not invoke it and must not contain an invocation slash command. If a person invokes an analyst directly, the analyst stops without writing a product file and tells the person in Ukrainian to run /formalizer. An analyst writes only when the prompt says formalizer started the pass and includes one input path ending in .xml or .txt. Before writing, it reads its own skill and its own rule, then that input, the three PDFs, docs/product/spec.md, docs/product/roadmap.md, docs/github.txt, and the public repository named in docs/github.txt. It does not edit the PDFs, roadmap.md, or github.txt, and it does not paste the thesis or the slides verbatim. product-analyst replaces the body of docs/product/spec.md with the English product description, covering the functional spec, UML stored as Markdown text, and identity management, and it links to architecture.md, error-handling.md, and concurrency.md. It does not create the other three files. architecture-analyst creates only docs/product/architecture.md. error-handling-analyst creates only docs/product/error-handling.md. concurrency-analyst creates only docs/product/concurrency.md. Each of those three files is English and covers only its own subject. Create .cursor/skills/product-analyst/SKILL.md, architecture-analyst/SKILL.md, error-handling-analyst/SKILL.md, and concurrency-analyst/SKILL.md. Each skill uses name and description frontmatter and sets disable-model-invocation to true. The skill states the one file that agent may write and repeats the source and conflict rules above. Do not create a skill for formalizer or translator. Create .cursor/rules/product-analyst.mdc, architecture-analyst.mdc, error-handling-analyst.mdc, and concurrency-analyst.mdc with alwaysApply false. The globs are docs/product/spec.md, docs/product/architecture.md, docs/product/error-handling.md, and docs/product/concurrency.md respectively. Each rule is the English writing contract for that one file and names the one analyst allowed to write it. It does not permit advisor, planner, builder, tester, reviewer, formalizer, or translator to rewrite the file. translator is explicit only and is invoked with /translator. It reads the four English files and the formalizer report pair. If either report file is missing, or either file lacks the line integrity: ok or lacks the line conflicts: none, it stops without writing. Otherwise it writes Ukrainian local/block-0/product.md, architecture.md, error-handling.md, and concurrency.md. It does not upload to Drive, does not edit the English product files, does not edit the report, and tells the developer in Ukrainian to upload those four files to https://drive.google.com/drive/u/2/folders/1K_oQmswetdSEb_ag_MTFLbUT1uc6pkeS. Neither formalizer nor translator writes into audit/advisor/.
